overview: Three-site matched case-control study: cases from the tertiary ED (index dates March 2023 to December 2025) and the two community EDs (from each program's start in 2024), with four controls per case sampled by incidence density within the same site.
population: Adults meeting the frequent attender definition at any of the three EDs, with index dates from each site's program start to December 2025.
exposure: Case management enrolment before the index date, read from the site's case management files; time since enrolment and contact count (with a written guide, because agreement on contacts is only moderate) as secondary exposures.
procedures: Cases are identified from regional linked ED, hospital and death data. For each case, four controls are sampled from frequent attenders at the same site still at risk on the case's event date, matched on age band, sex and calendar month. The two research assistants read files at all three sites with one abstraction guide; 10 percent of files at each site are read twice. Site extracts are de-identified before leaving the site.

outcomes.name: Odds ratio for death or ICU admission with enrolment
outcomes.measure: Conditional odds ratio for enrolment before the index date, cases against within-site matched controls
outcomes.why: The association the health authority needs.

outcomes.name: Odds ratio for death alone
outcomes.measure: Conditional odds ratio restricted to cases who died
outcomes.why: Death is the most important component.

outcomes.name: Time since enrolment
outcomes.measure: Odds ratios by time since enrolment (under 6 months, 6 to 12, over 12)

outcomes.name: Site-specific associations
outcomes.measure: Odds ratios by site with a test of heterogeneity
outcomes.why: Program intensity differs by site (claim c4).

outcomes.name: Abstractor agreement by site
outcomes.measure: Kappa for enrolment date on the double-read sample at each site

outcomes.name: Unavailable or incomplete files by site
outcomes.measure: Proportion of sampled patients whose file cannot be found or is incomplete
outcomes.why: Differential missingness by site would bias the estimate.

feasibility: About 291 cases and 1,164 controls: about 290 enrolled files at 45 minutes and about 1,165 checks at 15 minutes, roughly 510 research-assistant hours of the 1,080 available to June 2027.
biasMitigation: Matching on age band, sex and calendar month within site
Adjustment for prior visits, comorbidity, mental health diagnosis, housing instability and family doctor attachment
One abstraction guide and double reading at every site

biasFlags.label: Confounding by indication
biasFlags.note: Complex patients enrolled first (claim c2); matching and adjustment limit but do not remove it.

biasFlags.label: Site differences in files
biasFlags.note: Community sites started later and use nurses; unavailable files are reported by site.

biasFlags.label: Control sampling
biasFlags.note: Incidence density sampling within site (claim c5).

flags: One primary outcome; death alone is a secondary component, not a second primary
parsimony.simplestPath: Three sites, within-site matching, one exposure, one outcome definition.

theoreticalFramework: Case-control design with incidence density sampling; no further framework.
summary: Three-site protocol with within-site matching; one primary outcome, site-specific secondary estimates and abstraction quality measures.
